name: inspira-icon-cloud
blurb: 3D rotating icon sphere responds to drag rotation and click-to-focus.
description: A canvas-rendered 3D sphere of circular icons distributed via golden-ratio sphere packing. Rotates with mouse drag, smoothly animates when clicked to bring selected icon to face the viewer.
use_when: Tech stack showcases, skill clouds, or immersive icon galleries requiring 3D visual depth and interactivity.
avoid_when: Touch-only devices without mouse drag support; no keyboard navigation or built-in focus management.
a11y: Canvas has aria-label; mouse drag rotation and click interaction are not keyboard accessible without external handling.
